tasks.title: Install sonner and mount Toaster in App.tsx
tasks.description: Install the sonner package in the web frontend. Add `<Toaster />` from sonner to `AppContent` in `App.tsx`, inside the `<BrowserRouter>` tree at the top level of the app layout div, before `<Header>`.
acceptanceCriteria: sonner is listed in packages/cli/web/package.json dependencies
packages/cli/web/node_modules/sonner exists
<Toaster /> from sonner is rendered in AppContent component
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
tasks.notes: Run: cd packages/cli/web && npm install sonner

tasks.title: Create useDocumentTitle hook
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/web/src/hooks/useDocumentTitle.ts` with a hook that accepts a title string and optional active boolean. Sets `document.title` to `(active ? '● ' : '') + title`. Restores previous title on unmount via useRef.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook file exists at packages/cli/web/src/hooks/useDocumentTitle.ts
Hook sets document.title to the provided title prefixed with '● ' when active is true
Hook sets document.title to the provided title without prefix when active is false or omitted
Hook restores previous document.title on component unmount
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli/web && npx tsc --noEmit

tasks.title: Add mutation success/error toasts in useQueries.ts
tasks.description: Add `import { toast } from 'sonner'` to useQueries.ts. For each of the 18 listed mutation hooks, add `toast.success(message)` in the existing `onSuccess` callback. Add `onError` callback with `toast.error(err.message || 'Request failed')` where not already present.
acceptanceCriteria: toast.success is called in onSuccess for all 18 mutation hooks listed in the spec
toast.error is called in onError for mutations, showing err.message or fallback 'Request failed'
useQuery hooks do NOT call toast
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
tasks.notes: Mutation hooks: useCreateProject, useDeleteProject, useUseProject, useSendMessage, useUnarchiveIssue, useSaveProvider, useDeleteProvider, useRebuildSystem, useUpdateConfig, useUpdateOpencodeModel, useSetModel, useSetOpencodeModelConfig, useSetLogLevel, useSetAgentRuntime, useSetStageModels, useCreateExploreSession, useUpdateExploreSessionTitle, useTestProvider. Also covers specs/toast-notifications/spec.md#mutation-error-toasts

tasks.title: Add SSE background event toasts in useSSE.tsx
tasks.description: Add toast calls in the SSE event handler for: agent_paused (info), agent_error (error), rebase_conflict with status=failed (error), merge_completed (success), merge_failed (error). Only show toast when the event's issue is NOT the currently viewed issue. Use a ref tracking the current issue number from window.location.pathname.
acceptanceCriteria: agent_paused SSE event shows info toast 'Issue #N needs approval' only when not viewing that issue
agent_error SSE event shows error toast 'Issue #N encountered an error' only when not viewing that issue
rebase_conflict with status=failed shows error toast 'Rebase conflict on Issue #N'
merge_completed shows success toast 'Issue #N merged successfully'
merge_failed shows error toast 'Merge failed for Issue #N'
No toast shown when the event's issue matches the currently viewed issue (for agent_paused, agent_error)
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
tasks.notes: Parse current issue number from window.location.pathname matching /issue/(\d+). Use a useRef updated on location change.

tasks.title: Wire useDocumentTitle into all page components
tasks.description: Add useDocumentTitle calls to each page component: KanbanView ('Mohist'), IssueDetailPage ('Issue #N — Mohist'), SessionPage ('Session — Issue #N — Mohist'), ExploreSessionList ('Explore — Mohist'), ExplorePage ('Explore — Mohist'), SettingsPage ('Settings — Mohist'), LogsPage ('Logs — Mohist'), ArchivedPage ('Archived — Mohist'). For IssueDetailPage and KanbanView, also read useAgentStatus and pass active=true when agent is running. Also covers specs/dynamic-page-title/spec.md#page-title-indicates-live-agent-activity.
acceptanceCriteria: KanbanView sets title to 'Mohist', prefixed with '● ' when agent is running
IssueDetailPage sets title to 'Issue #N — Mohist', prefixed with '● ' when agent is running
SessionPage sets title to 'Session — Issue #N — Mohist'
ExploreSessionList sets title to 'Explore — Mohist'
ExplorePage sets title to 'Explore — Mohist'
SettingsPage sets title to 'Settings — Mohist'
LogsPage sets title to 'Logs — Mohist'
ArchivedPage sets title to 'Archived — Mohist'
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
tasks.notes: KanbanView is defined in App.tsx, not a separate component file.

tasks.title: Build verification and final integration check
tasks.description: Run the full build and typecheck to verify all changes integrate correctly. Ensure no regressions in existing tests.
acceptanceCriteria: cd packages/cli && npm run build succeeds
cd packages/cli && npm test passes (no test regressions)
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit
